outcome.outcome: Small-batch and molecularly diverse devices become fabricable without a multi-billion-dollar fab, so nanoscale device research stops being rationed by access to a handful of facilities.
outcome.rationale: Their description names versatility and small-scale assembly as what current fabs foreclose.

ai_types.rationale: Digital assembly, laser direct write and modular nano-electronics are all fabrication-hardware capabilities.

measurability.rationale: Capital cost per wafer start, minimum economic batch size and feature size achievable are direct facility metrics.

outcome.outcome: Atoms can be placed where they are specified rather than where chemistry prefers, making arbitrary molecular structures buildable rather than only discoverable.
outcome.rationale: Their description traces the ambition from Feynman and Drexler through DNA origami to protein carpentry, and the unlock is positional control itself.

ai_types.rationale: Their proposed route is designing modular protein building blocks with programmable binding, which is de novo design at a scale and precision not demonstrated.
Molecular 3D printing and vacuum mechanosynthesis are fabrication capabilities with no working instance.

measurability.rationale: Positional placement accuracy and per-step assembly yield are direct and unambiguous, which is why their own text can be candid about the risk of failing.

outcome.outcome: Cells become buildable from specified parts rather than borrowed from evolution, so synthetic biology stops inheriting mechanisms nobody has characterised.
outcome.rationale: Their description names the reliance on kludgy evolved cells as the limit on fully customisable biological systems.

ai_types.rationale: A bottom-up synthetic cell requires designing a compatible full parts list, which is a design problem far past current demonstrated scope.

measurability.rationale: Whether a bottom-up construct self-replicates, and how many functions are supplied by designed rather than borrowed components, are direct and countable.

notes: All three tier-1 but all with speculative-maturity primaries: the goals are unambiguous and the capability is absent. The cleanest example in the map of measurable-but-far, which is the opposite failure mode to the origins questions.
